messages:
eli: Quick sync — we need to roll a small audit_event schema change to prod next month. Plan is to remove actor_email (PII risk) and add actor_display_name + actor_roles array.
meera: Removing actor_email — do we have customer contracts that rely on it? any legal sign-off needed?
ben: FYI this will affect RBAC downstream checks that currently lookup by email. We'll need a mapping step. Suggest event_version: 2 on the root envelope.
kate: Can we offer a validation endpoint for customers to test their parsers against v2 events? e.g., /audit/validate?v=2 that returns OK/errors.
eli: Yes, validation endpoint is in scope. Also want a short migration window: staged rollout behind ff + canary in us-west for 48h.
security-bot: Spec draft: https://internal.redwood/specs/audit-event-v2 (brief). Highlights: add event_version:int, actor_display_name:string, actor_roles:[string], remove actor_email. Include backwards-compat shim for one release.
ben: About RBAC: we'll add actor_identity.id (internal GUID) to the envelope so authorizers can map without email. We'll publish a compatibility shim that populates actor_identity.id from existing user store during transition.
meera: KMS question — any fields newly encrypted? We currently wrap actor_email with KMS for logs in some customers. If we drop actor_email, make sure we don't break KMS audit flows.
eli: Good catch. Plan: keep encrypted_actor_email in telemetry for 90 days behind feature flag so KMS-backed archives don't break, then purge. Not in public event payload.
kate: Customer-facing validation API should return example payloads and diff hints. Example for v1 -> v2:
```
// v1
{"event_version":1, "actor_email":"alice@acme.com", "action":"deploy"}
// v2
{"event_version":2, "actor_display_name":"Alice L.", "actor_roles":["dev"], "actor_identity":"user_1234", "action":"deploy"}
```
ben: Migration checklist: 1) spec PR + unit tests, 2) validator + endpoint, 3) shim write to enrich v2 events in ingest, 4) RBAC service update to use actor_identity, 5) canary, 6) gradual rollout, 7) purge encrypted_actor_email.
kate: I'll own the validator and docs. ETA: 2026-04-10 for beta.
eli: I'll own rollout and coordination with SRE. ben you own RBAC changes?
ben: Yep. I'll add e2e tests by 2026-04-05.
meera: I'll check legal and CSM for customer contracts that mention actor_email.
security-bot: Automated test run scheduled: `ci/audit-v2/spec-check` triggered.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled to us-west with ff=audit_v2_canary at 2026-04-20T03:00Z.
eli: One more: we should include a deprecation header in event metadata for v1 events: `deprecated_until=2026-07-01`. Customers get three months to adapt.
kate: Docs note: Include JSON schema link + example curl to validator. I'll add to the public changelog.
ben: Also add telemetry for parser errors per-customer so we can proactively reach out.
eli: Action items recap: kate -> validator/docs; ben -> RBAC + tests; meera -> contracts/legal + CSM notice; eli -> rollout/SRE + purge plan. We'll reconvene next Tue to confirm dates.
meera: Sounds good. Any objections to the three-month deprecation window?
ben: Fine from infra side.
kate: fine.
eli: No objections. Marking this thread resolved for now, will post follow-ups as PRs land. :thumbsup:
